fire: The lab counted living and dead yeast cells in each sample.

Cardiopulmonary resuscitation should start within minutes.
Fish gills extract dissolved oxygen from the water.
Basal metabolic rate falls slightly with age.
Aerobic respiration releases far more energy than fermentation.
The tissue became hypoxic when blood flow stopped.
Mitochondria convert glucose and oxygen into usable energy.

Obligate passengers are charged for exposure to delays.
Cardboard recycling should start within the month.
Fish markets extract a fee from every seller.
Basal reading levels rise slightly with age.
Aerobic classes attract more people than yoga.
The tissue paper became wet when the rain started.
Machines convert grain and water into usable flour.
